Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Proxima Fusion is hiring an Alpha Plasma Microwave Modeler in Munich to own the physics simulation pipeline connecting our gyrotron sources to plasma performance. You will model the propagation, polarization and absorption of millimeter waves in the Alpha stellarator, running ray-tracing and beam-tracing codes such as TRAVIS and RAYTRAX and validating against W7-X experimental data to drive the design of the Alpha ECRH launcher. You will model Electron Cyclotron Current Drive and build Python post-processing pipelines. It suits physicists with hands-on experience of an EC propagation or absorption code.

  • Run ray-tracing and beam-tracing simulations of EC wave propagation and absorption using codes such as TRAVIS, RAYTRAX and more complex beam or full wave model codes

jobs.description:
Build a better world with data

We are looking for an experienced Sales Manager to develop our business and channel for our videosurveillance portfolio. This role will report to the Solution Team Manager and will be based in our Paris office with frequent travel to other regions to meet partners, customers and prospects.
The Solution Team regroups technical experts, pre-sales engineers and solution-focused sales.

jobs.description:
Du hast schon mal etwas mit KI gebaut, das danach wirklich jemand benutzt hat, und willst nicht wieder ein Praktikum, in dem du Folien formatierst?

Dann lies weiter.

Aufgaben

Was du hier machst

Immotalente besetzt kaufmännische Stellen in Hausverwaltungen. Dahinter läuft ein selbstgebautes System: Kandidaten werden gefunden, bewertet und angeschrieben, über sechzehn Mandate hinweg. Dazu ein Wissensspeicher, in dem Mandate, Kunden und Abläufe liegen und aus dem heraus KI-Agenten arbeiten.

Das System funktioniert, und es hat Lücken. Du arbeitest an beidem.

Du baust Agenten für Aufgaben, die heute Handarbeit sind. Interviewnotizen zu Kandidatendossiers. Kundebriefings zu Mandatsakten. Prüfläufe, die melden, wenn eine Tabelle still aufgehört hat zu rechnen. Terminvorschläge, Nachfassen, Berichte.

Du entwickelst die Textqualität weiter. Die Ansprachetexte an Kandidaten klingen noch nach Maschine. Woran das liegt, ist analysiert und dokumentiert. Es umzusetzen ist offen, und es ist die Arbeit mit dem größten Hebel.

Du schließt Lücken im Bestand.

jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

jobs.title: Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

We are developing a next-generation electric aircraft propulsion system, with the propulsion battery designed, developed, and validated in-house. Accurate real-time observation and prediction of the battery’s State of Function (SoF), the energy and power actually accessible for safe flight and landing, is the safety-critical output of the battery system, and the basis for pre-flight planning, in-flight energy management, and the energy information presented to the crew.

SoF is built on the underlying battery states that your algorithms observe and predict: state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), state of power (SoP), state of energy (SoE), and state of balance (SoB). Erroneous observation or prediction of SoF is classified as a catastrophic condition, since it can lead the crew to commit to a flight or an approach the battery cannot support. This makes the function certification-critical and places exacting demands on the accuracy, robustness, and verifiability of every algorithm you deliver.
